questions_and_answers.question_text: हमारी गाड़ी बड़ी मुश्किल से वहां तक पहुँच सकी ।

answers.answer_text: Our car could reach there with great difficulty.

questions_and_answers.question_text: वे किसी न किसी तरह अपने घर पहुँच सके ।

answers.answer_text: They somehow managed to reach their home.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उनकी पढ़ाई का काम आज पूरा हो सका ।

answers.answer_text: Their study work was completed today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: मेरे मित्र दो साल के बाद अपने माता-पिता से मिल सके ।

answers.answer_text: My friend was able to meet his parents after two years.

questions_and_answers.question_text: कल मैं उनसे समय पर नहीं मिल सका ।

answers.answer_text: Yesterday I could not meet him on time.

questions_and_answers.question_text: परसों हमारे बच्चे सिनेमां देखने नहीं जा सके ।

answers.answer_text: The day before yesterday our children couldn't go to the cinema.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उनके फ़क़सर की पत्नी पार्टी में नहीं आ सकी ।

answers.answer_text: Their professor's wife couldn't come to the party.

questions_and_answers.question_text: मुझे बहुत अफ़सोस है कि उनकी बिल्ली बीमारी से बच न सकी ।

answers.answer_text: I'm very sorry that their cat couldn't survive the illness.

questions_and_answers.question_text: न तो मेरे दोस्त यहाँ रह सके और न वे वहाँ पहुँच सके ।

answers.answer_text: Neither could my friends stay here nor could they reach there.
